item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean

Friday: N wind 5 to 10 kt becoming E in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 2 ft.

Friday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Increasing clouds. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday: ENE wind 10 to 15 kt. Showers, mainly after 2pm. The rain could be heavy at times. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday Night: E wind around 10 kt. Showers, mainly before 2am. The rain could be heavy at times. Seas around 2 ft.

Sunday: Variable winds 5 kt or less. A chance of showers. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Sunday Night: SSW wind 5 to 10 kt. A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 2am, then a chance of showers between 2am and 3am. Seas around 3 ft.

Monday: SW wind around 10 kt. Partly sunny. Seas around 3 ft.
